verdict.description: Two or three sentences. What this set of screens is, what is most wrong with it, and whether you would hand it to a client as it stands.

scores.description: One entry per criterion in the lens rubric. 0-5, where 3 is 'a competent product ships this'.

why.description: One sentence naming the pixels that set this score.

title.description: One line, the defect itself. Not the fix.

surface.description: Surface name from the evidence list.

where.description: A CSS selector or a described region of the screenshot. "the button" is not a location.

evidence.description: Which screenshot or which measured fact shows this. Name the file or the number.

fix.description: The smallest change that resolves it.
